product_one_liner.value: Scandit provides businesses with vision-AI smart data capture on smart devices—scanning barcodes, text, IDs and objects to automate workflows and deliver actionable insights for frontline workers and customer experiences.
product_one_liner.notes: Scandit describes smart data capture for frontline workers and customer experiences, with barcode, ID, text and object capture that automates processes and provides insights.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage links to Scandit's pricing URL, which has a pricing page and a quote request option.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Scandit's customer-stories page includes a VF Corporation case study and a testimonial attributed to a Shipt principal engineer. | named_customers.0: The customer-stories page names VF Corporation and links its case study. | named_customers.1: The customer-stories page identifies a testimonial speaker as a principal engineer at Shipt.

employee_band.notes: Workforce reporting places Scandit at about 326 employees, and a company profile reports a 251–500 headcount range; both fall in the requested 201–500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Scandit's company page identifies Zurich as its global headquarters city. | hq_country: Scandit's company page explicitly labels Zurich, Switzerland as its global headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Scandit's company page states it was founded in 2009.

eng_blog.notes: The Scandit blog has at least two technical posts by its CTO: one discusses the Vision AI Engine's codebase and machine-learning models, and another explains how ShelfView is built and processes shelf images.

public_docs.notes: Scandit provides a public developer documentation site with framework-specific product guidance and technical instructions.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current Scandit application posting is for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer role and describes building machine-learning models.

model_provider.value: Scandit Vision AI Engine (using machine learning and vision-language models; no external model provider is publicly named).
model_provider.notes: Scandit names its own Vision AI Engine and says ID verification combines machine learning and VLMs. Its current subprocessor list does not identify a third-party AI model provider, so the answer names Scandit's engine and avoids attributing an undisclosed external provider.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security page names ISO 27001:2022 certification and separately states GDPR compliance; both are among the compliance items requested. | compliance_certs.0: The security page explicitly calls Scandit ISO 27001:2022 certified. | compliance_certs.1: The same page explicitly states compliance with GDPR; GDPR is included in the requested compliance items.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile identifies Series D as Scandit's latest round. | funding_date: The funding profile dates Scandit's latest round to February 9, 2022, which is 2022-02 in the requested format. | funding_amount_usd: The funding history identifies a latest Series D on February 9, 2022, and Scandit's announcement states that round raised $150 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent disclosed round was February 9, 2022, well before the 18-month window ending in November 2026; therefore Scandit did not raise within that period.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Scandit's live Greenhouse job board lists a Business Development Representative opening, which is within the requested SDR/BDR/AE titles.

launched_6mo.notes: The Scandit blog index lists September 15, 2026 posts, including a Product Releases announcement for its self-checkout loss-prevention solution; that launch falls within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Tom Karrat's profile shows him as Scandit's Chief Revenue Officer beginning in January 2026, within the 12 months before the run date.
